findings.summary: grounded.answer.v1 can bypass a typed verifier and end SUCCEEDED; it conflicts with the ADR 0028 acceptance gate on task-bound runs, and the release report cannot tell GROUNDED from VERIFIED.
T23: finding expected/observed text and read errors reach the model fenced but unmasked, so the on exemption for hosted routes leaks personal data through findings.
The fence escaping rule maps <, > and & to themselves; the escape sequences are lost, so the only T1 fence defence is unspecified.
Rationale summary and alternatives stored as model text in proposal.created deviate from the plan's ids-only payload constraint without a flagged exception.
Acceptance step 3 (full gate) had no evidence when reviewed; close ritual not yet run.
ADR 0031 lists observed_at as an approval-digest input; it is not one.
Reason-code count: ADR 0032 says eight, ADR 0033 adds a ninth (GROUNDED).
ADR 0030 gives no readiness basis for an undeclared route defaulting to hosted:unknown.
Rationale check before validation is a semantic change to target 5.6; point the owner at ADR 0033's alternative at G2.

Re-review: a domain finding's message was kept unmasked on the unchecked assumption that it is rule text; SHACL resultMessage and extra_findings can carry values. It is now rendered from the inventory by rule_id on unprotected routes, or masked.
Re-review: KERNEL-* expected/observed now stated to carry only ids, pointers, digests, counts and codes.
Re-review: ADR 0033 and its index row now name ADR 0028 as refined (AcceptanceSpec.grounded_answer).
